description: Simulator-owned mapping from message type to visual representation (FR-25..FR-28 / G8). Deliberately NOT part of interface-schema.json: neither the DKM nor its headers carry visualization metadata, so this file can change freely without touching the interface contract.

conventions.polarToCartesian: x = distance * cos(heading), y = distance * sin(heading)
conventions.note: FR-26: this MUST match what the DKM actually computes, otherwise the operator sees a different inside/outside verdict than the DKM applied.

beamIndex.note: Feeds the BEAM_HEADING lookup below, mirroring mock_r's BeamReportBuffer: the most recent heading announced for each beam id.

mappings.note: A JammerReport carries no bearing of its own -- it names a beam. The bearing is resolved from the most recent BeamReport with that beam_id, mirroring mock_r's BeamReportBuffer lookup. Unknown beam_id renders nothing, exactly as mock_r drops it.

A rotating antenna announces tens of beams a second, so a long persistence turns the display into a starburst that buries everything under it. A short one leaves a bright sweep with a fading tail behind it -- readable, and what a plan display actually looks like.
